updates.title: Purview Endpoint DLP: FTP and SFTP Transfer Monitoring
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now monitors sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols, allowing admins to enforce restrictive actions based on organizational policy. This expands data protection coverage beyond standard web and cloud transfer methods to legacy file transfer protocols.

updates.title: Purview Information Protection: Auto-Labeling for Legacy Office Formats
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview's server-side auto-labeling is being extended to support legacy Office file formats (.doc, .xls, .ppt) stored in SharePoint and OneDrive. This allows organizations to automatically classify and label older file formats alongside modern Office documents.

updates.title: 8 Authorization Vulnerabilities Patched in Microsoft Edge (Chromium)
updates.summary: Microsoft Edge has ingested security patches from Chromium addressing multiple authorization vulnerabilities across various components. These CVEs span missing or incorrect authorization in Video, Chromoting, BrowserTag, Downloads, WebProtect, USB, Extensions, and SiteIsolation, requiring immediate updates to maintain security posture.
